description: Designs and develops responsive frontend interfaces and scalable backend services, integrating APIs, databases, and modern cloud deployment pipelines.
Builds high-performance, interactive, and accessible web user interfaces using modern client-side frameworks, responsive styling, and state management.
Architects resilient server-side applications, microservices, high-throughput database interactions, caching layers, and asynchronous messaging pipelines.
Extracts predictive insights from structured and unstructured data using statistical modeling, feature engineering, machine learning, and deep learning algorithms.
Analyzes complex datasets, designs executive dashboards, identifies business trends, and drives data-informed decisions across business units.
Builds, optimizes, and productionizes machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI models at scale with continuous inference and MLOps.
Automates cloud infrastructure provisioning, container orchestration, CI/CD deployment pipelines, system observability, and security hardening.
Develops clean, modular Python applications, automated data processing scripts, backends, and integrations using Python idioms and packages.
Engineers cross-platform or native mobile applications with smooth gestures, local data persistence, and performant API communications.
Ensures software quality, reliability, and regression resilience through automated end-to-end testing frameworks, unit testing, and continuous verification.
Develops intelligent agentic workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, fine-tunes LLMs, and deploys scalable AI applications.
